parsed.explanation: Structural signals dominate: a totalitarian regime with total control over civil society, no space for LGBT life, official hostility (2014 state-media denial and slur), undefined discretionary morality provisions (Arts. 193, 262) usable at official judgment, zero recourse, no civil society or registration route, and documented executions of detainees for homosexuality (2014 camp execution, 2011 couple report — dated and defector-sourced, so not a current prevalence measure). If outed, a trans visitor faces state-administered severity up to imprisonment or execution with no remedy — tier 2/state-directed. It is not 0.05 because no documented near-certain identification-to-execution campaign against trans visitors exists, and border screening is unsourced. Thin data extrapolates from the regime's documented character: forced concealment, discretionary punishment, no protection. Subnational variation is unknowable.
